item: Every merge to main gets its own full CI run (R612: the default branch's concurrency group is keyed by commit)
summary: A concurrency group holds one pending run, so each merge to main replaced the queued run of the merge before it (#1812, #1818, #1824 showed cancelled on 2026-11-08). The default branch's group is now keyed by github.sha with cancel-in-progress false; every other ref keeps one group per ref and cancels its superseded run. tests/test_ci_concurrency.py evaluates both expressions for main and PR events and carries two mutants.
